name: example-web-llm
description: Template for a real web LLM chat page. Selectors are placeholders and MUST be filled in and verified before use.
notes: Unverified template. Workflow: 1) 'python -m app.browser.cli login --profile example-web-llm' and sign in manually in the headed window; 2) 'python -m app.browser.cli inspect --profile example-web-llm' to dump the DOM into runs/; 3) read the selectors off that snapshot and fill them in here; 4) 'python -m app.browser.cli ask --profile example-web-llm --prompt hi'. Login automation, captcha solving and fingerprint evasion are out of scope by project rules.
